query: Economist YouGov poll generic congressional ballot September 2026

results.content:
The short answer is that nobody knows yet, but according to RealClearPolling's average of over 13 national generic congressional ballot surveys, Democrats hold an advantage, with 48% of respondents saying they would vote Democratic compared with 42.3% who said they would vote Republican.

In a closer look at individual polls, this week's Economist/YouGov found the overall numbers may be leaving out a very important faction of undecided and unsure voters: [...] Election Day is Nov. 3, 2026. Voters will decide all 435 seats in the House of Representatives, dozens of Senate contests and numerous gubernatorial races around the country. The winners will shape the balance of power in Washington be
